text: Stash this: multi-database file support: Consider this: you want to be able to support multiple database files within Graphtor-docs so that you can have one for Rust, another one for C Sharp, and another one for Power BI to house all of your documentation that you need. You want to support that one content source or type and then be able to reuse that across multiple projects so that you don't have to re-ingest the data for every project using those sources.
